overall_reason: A recent-deploys list whose row grid breaks on the last row: an 'Ask AI' gradient pill replaces the time column and becomes the loudest mark in the card, level with the 'Deploy' action.

score.reason: T-SQUINT puts the 'Ask AI' pill level with the 'Deploy' button, and T-SKELETON finds the time column missing on row 3 and the meta line present on row 1 only.

findings.evidence: In 03-lenses/squint/1440-00.png the violet-to-pink pill at x=589, y=186 (81 by 22px) is the only saturated block in the card and reads as heavy as the black 'Deploy' button at x=609, y=40. The sweep's gradient, glow and look_family hits sit on the same pill.
findings.before: A gradient 'Ask AI' pill in the failed row competes with the card's primary 'Deploy' action.
findings.after: Make the failed state the row's signal (the red status icon and a plain text action such as 'Retry' or 'View log' in the time column), and keep 'Deploy' as the one filled control.
findings.why: The eye lands on a generic AI button before the header action or the failed status, so the card's order of importance is wrong.

findings.where: rows 2 and 3 of the deploys list, 1440
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json row 1 is 60px tall with a meta line ('main · Maya Chen'), rows 2 and 3 are 42 and 44px with no meta line, and row 3 has no time: the time column holds 'Just now' at x=624 and '12m ago' at x=623, then the 'Ask AI' pill at x=589.
findings.before: Three rows with three different anatomies.
findings.after: Put every row on one template: name, meta line, time; let missing data keep its track empty rather than giving the track to another control.
findings.why: A list scans by column; when one row drops its time and another drops its meta, the reader re-reads each row to find the same fact.

strengths: The header pairs the title 'Recent deploys' with a single filled 'Deploy' action on one line.
Status icons sit in one column at the same x on every row.
